input.title: Swap parent animation is broken when keyboard is up
input.body:
Tested on iOS Safari. 

Feature: #2528

## Steps to Reproduce

```
- A
  - B
```

1. Set the cursor on `B`.
2. Tap `B` to open the keyboard. 
2. Activate Swap Parent from the toolbar. 

## Current Behavior

The animation is choppy and cut off. 

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f6e4891b-d99d-4ca3-b9d0-20f23e848055

## Expected Behavior

There should be a smooth animation of `A` and `B` swapping places. 

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c48d9aa9-5d0b-46c2-8e1f-c3717357b1df
